topic: Singapore: Japanese occupation and wartime civilian life, 1942-1945
scope_decisions: The artifact set covers one topic only and stays within the 1942-1945 occupation window.
No canonical recipes, generator code, docs, or unrelated recipe folders were modified.
PDF-facing prose stays in English, with only controlled transliterated or translated benchmark terms where needed.
Exact casualty totals, ration quotas, and other unstable numeric claims are intentionally omitted.
decisions: The folder focuses on civilian experience, coercive control, food scarcity, internment, labour, and memory.
Syonan-to is used as a historical transliteration rather than as decorative terminology.
The narrative stops at the end of occupation and does not extend into postwar constitutional history.
